Grants 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Quickly tosses a <stasis Stasis /> shuriken that can ricochet off surfaces 3 times or hit as many as 4 enemies, tracking enemies within <pve 12 /> <pvp [8] /> meters.

Each hit deals <pve 296 /> <pvp [72] /> damage and applies <pve 60 /> <pvp [40] /> stacks of <stasis Slow /> for <pve 3.5 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds.

source.text:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Quickly tosses a Stasis Shuriken towards enemies.
Shurikens are able to ricochet up to 3 times off of surfaces or towards up to 4 enemies, tracking towards enemies within 12 [8] meters.

Withering Blades deal 296 [72] damage and inflict x60 [x40] Slow for 3.5+3.5 [1.5+0.5] seconds on hit.
Base Cooldown: 145.2 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.8x
